subject.title: fix(mattermost): backfill thread history from server when in-memory window is empty

question: After the 200-post request cap is fixed, should Mattermost cold-thread recovery keep the current awaited, one-attempt-per-stored-session policy?
rationale: The implementation deliberately trades up to a bounded cold-turn delay and possible session-long loss of recovered context after one transient failure for protection against repeated server calls; tests cannot choose that channel reliability policy.

options.title: Approve the bounded policy
options.body: Fix the 200-post cap, then accept one awaited fetch and no retry per stored session as the Mattermost recovery contract.

options.title: Require retry-safe recovery
options.body: Add a narrowly bounded retry or cooldown policy so a transient first failure does not suppress recovery for the rest of the session.

options.title: Reject inbound backfill
options.body: Pause or close the PR if an awaited Mattermost thread lookup is not acceptable on the inbound path.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded policy
recommendation.body: Fix the 200-post cap, then accept one awaited fetch and no retry per stored session as the Mattermost recovery contract.
